mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months reduces the discount rate applied to expected equity cash flows, increasing the present value of future dividends and earnings, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro easing periods, or walk-forward Rank IC < -0.05 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a flight to quality as investors shift from equities to safer assets, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 70% of tightening episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 150,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to increase investment in productive capacity and raising expected equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 50% of labor strengthening episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below -50,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, prompting firms to cut investment and lowering expected equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of labor weakening episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 102.5 signals robust manufacturing momentum, reducing supply-side bottlenecks and increasing expected corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 50% of high-INDPRO episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < -0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 98.5 indicates persistent supply-side constraints, compressing corporate profit expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 70% of low-INDPRO episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 330.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain higher policy rates, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of high-CPIAUCSL episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 320.0 indicates disinflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to cut policy rates, which lowers discount rates and increases equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 70% of low-CPIAUCSL episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < -0.06 over any 3-year window.
